# Medido

> Independent second opinion on what small businesses pay for marketing: reads a site from outside, verifies measurement, and delivers a written diagnosis. Flat fee, accounts in the client's name.

Website in English (https://marketingmedido.com/), Hebrew (https://marketingmedido.com/he/) and Spanish (https://marketingmedido.com/es/). The text below is taken from the English site, where Medido writes in the first person.

Home page: "A second opinion on what you pay for marketing. Before you renew with your agency, read what you actually have." I don't run your ads and my fee is flat, never a percentage of what you spend. Paste your website: in under a minute you'll see what I can verify from outside, what I can't, and how to check each thing yourself.

## The free reading

- What a reading is: I open your home page in a real Chrome browser, two or three times, and write down every request it makes: Google Analytics, Tag Manager, the Meta pixel, ad tags and others. On each reading I click On each reading I click one WhatsApp, one phone and one email link on the home page and count what they send. on the home page and count what they send. Everything I do is a real request: it can appear in your analytics and ad accounts as visits and contact events from a Chrome browser whose user agent ends in MedidoLupa/0.2. Filter it out by that string. I read the public domain registry, the robots file, the sitemap and the structured data. I don't log in, I don't click cookie banners and I don't submit any form. The browser keeps the cookies your site sets during the visit and discards them at the end.
- The seals: Verified: my browser saw it in this run, with a record of the request, the event and the count, on the date and time shown on the reading. Inferred: my conclusion from what I saw, still to be confirmed. Not seen: I didn't see it in this run, which is never the same as "it doesn't exist." The four main findings carry a seal and the code enforces it: without a record of evidence there is no "verified". When a result depends on a single load, it can't be "verified".
- What it can't see: Who administers your accounts, what you spent, what the platform ultimately counts as a conversion, events sent from a server, whether Google indexed a page, which sales call actually closed and who signed, and what an AI assistant says about you. Those need your accounts or repeated questions, and I say so.
- A reading is automatic and has no human review, so it can be wrong.

## Steps and published prices

My fee is flat, never a percentage of what you spend, and I don't run your ads. Prices are in US dollars, with the minimum spend that makes each step worth it. Below that, the free reading and the questions for your agency are the honest answer.

- Reading: Free. Facts about your site with a seal, what I couldn't see, and how to check each one. No signup. Fits: Any spend.
- Second reading: US$5 with your coupon (Hebrew site: 15 ILS plus VAT). Your first reading comes with a coupon: after you make the changes, get a new reading of your site for US$5 and see what was fixed, what stayed the same, what is new, and what I still can't see or verify. Fits: Any spend.
- Reading session: US$160 · with a written note US$190 (Hebrew site: 500 ILS / 600 ILS plus VAT). The report can be hard to read, and that is normal. So I offer 45 minutes with me to go through your reading, explain the findings and map out the first steps. You choose: the conversation only, or the conversation plus a written note that guides each step. Fully credited against the Diagnosis if you continue within 14 days. Fits: Any spend.
- Diagnosis: US$925 (Hebrew site: 2,900 ILS plus VAT). What is wrong today, and is it worth what you pay? A snapshot of your last quarter, delivered once, in 10 business days: a written report and a 45-minute call. Page 1 is a verdict about your agency or provider (Keep, Change or Stop) with a dollar figure next to it. Then what is measured wrong, where budget is misplaced, who owns what, and what to ask for. Verifying the fixes is one of its modules. Fits: From about US$5k a month.
- Watch: US$150 a month (Hebrew site: 470 ILS a month plus VAT). Every week I re-read your site and write only when something really changes: a tag disappears, an event doubles, a domain nears expiration. One number and one decision a month. Fits: US$5k to US$15k a month.
- Quarter: US$1,920 a month (Hebrew site: 6,000 ILS a month plus VAT). For those who will act on it and want someone checking, every month, that the money goes where it should. Month-to-month, first month on signing. Month 1 builds the base. Months 2 and 3 focus on decisions about your budget: written recommendations for your team, a check that each one was done and is being measured, a weekly page, a monthly call. If you already paid for the Diagnosis, it is deducted from month 1 if you continue within 14 days. Fits: From about US$15k a month.

## Questions

- Do you run my ads? No. Flat fee, never a percentage of your spend, so my income doesn't grow when your spend grows. I also sell follow-up services, so judge my verdict by the evidence I show.
- Who owns the accounts? You, from day one. Ads, analytics, domain and social accounts stay in your name; you can leave whenever you want and lose nothing.
- Is the work subcontracted? No. I do the work. I use software to read and draft, I check what I send, and I am responsible for it.
- What do you keep of my site? Not the page. For 30 days, a short technical record (tracking IDs, event counts, the domain's expiration date) so I can tell you what changed, for 90 days a usage counter with a scrambled domain, and with no time limit the site's address, the dates and the coupon, so that each site gets only one free reading. Ask me to delete the record and the counter any time. My reader identifies itself as MedidoLupa and honors a robots.txt rule that blocks it. To keep it off your site, add that rule or write to me.
- Why in writing? Because it leaves a record you can forward to your agency or your accountant, and you aren't tied to my calendar.
- What do you need from me? For the reading, only your website. For the Diagnosis, read-only access to your accounts (no passwords) and 30 minutes at the start.
